title: Ninne Preminthunu – Reenukumar, Sam Alex Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నా జీవం నీవేగా, నా స్తుతియు నీవేగా
నా పాపము చూడక, నీ ముఖమును దాచితివే
english: Naa jeevam neevegaa, naa sthuthiyu neevegaa
Naa paapamu choodaka, nee mukhamunu daachithive
translation: You are my life, You are my praise
Though You died for me, I will live for You
Without looking at my sin, You hid Your face
Not counting my transgressions, You gave me Your grace
When I asked for forgiveness, You said You forgot them
When I was in suffering, You were with me
Even though everyone left me, You held me close
You heard my prayer, You wiped away my tears

credits.Vocals: Pastor Reenukumar, Sam Alex, Sabi Thankachan & Rhea Reenukumar

intro: Ninne Preminthunu is the latest Telugu Christian song written & composed by Pastor Reenukumar, sung by Pastor Reenukumar, Sam Alex, Sabi Thankachan, Rhea Reenukumar and music composed by Mervin Solomon, produced by Pastor Reenukumar. This song was released on March 07, 2026, through Reenukumar YouTube Channel.
